_comment: PreToolUse hook: runs scripts/security_guard.py (installed to ~/.claude/hooks/) before every Bash tool call to block catastrophic commands and confirm risky ones. Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/merge_settings.py; identified for removal by the 'security_guard' marker in the command.

hooks.command: PY=python3; python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 || PY=python; $PY -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1 || PY="uv run --no-project python"; $PY "$HOME/.claude/hooks/security_guard.py"
